log.hypothesis: Calibration capture: block-0 MLP inputs (recoverable via pinv of fc1) should allow a linear readout of log pT / log E for inserted photons and neutral hadrons with error well below 0.1 in log units, and pid 6/7 should be linearly separable with a large margin.

Stage-1 detector units (inverted, exact-zero on kept tokens) in block 0: sub-threshold neutral hadrons get the +512*s flag and photons with pT<0.8 get channel 648 pushed by -256; all other tokens' block-0 outputs are unchanged up to ~1e-4 rounding. This capture calibrates the block-1 photon-energy readout.
Forward jets with inserted photons (pT<0.8, E around 1.8 GeV) give enough A-flagged photons near the E threshold to fit the block-1 log-E readout to ~0.005 rms for the stage-2 AND unit.

Residual-stream statistics for designing per-block key-suppression readouts. Kept tokens are bit-identical to the original model up to ~1e-4 rounding; flagged soft photons (last 60 jets) sit at the saturated vertex w*s in every block from block 2 on.

Summary-token states inside the classifier head (queries of classifier block 1), needed to design the classifier-head key/query flag terms. Kept tokens are unchanged relative to the original up to rounding.

Full circuit: exact-zero detector units (block 0: photon pT<0.8 and neutral-hadron E<2.2; block 1: photon AND E<1.8) push dropped tokens to a saturated vertex; rank-2 q/k flag terms in all 27 later body blocks and both classifier blocks suppress that vertex by >=8 nats. Expect a large drop of E_rule, with residual error from block-0/1 leakage, kNN neighbourhoods and the late-block kept-logit perturbation (~0.1 nats).

Same detector, suppression only in body blocks 1-13 and the two classifier blocks. The late-block kept-logit perturbation disappears, so clean e should drop clearly; the flagged vertex now leaks in blocks 14-27, so the rule ratios get worse.

Block-0 MLP inputs on forward jets with inserted near-threshold photons; refitting the stage-1 pT readout on cal1+cal2 should remove the few 0.04-0.08 misses seen on forward jets (readout error near threshold < 0.005).

Refit stage 1 (cal1+cal2), photon pT flag now written as +256*s on 256 channels. Photons with pT<0.8 should reach block 1 saturated on those channels (for block-1 suppression), while the other channels keep enough log-E information for the stage-2 AND unit (readout rmse < 0.005 near 1.8 GeV).

v3: refit stage-1 (no forward-jet misses), photon pT flag as a 256-channel push so photons are also suppressed in block 1, stage-2 AND unit plus an un-push unit for photons above 1.8 GeV; suppression in blocks 1-13 and classifier. Removing block-1 leakage for photons should lower soft1e-4 and soft1e-3 errors below pass 13.
v4 = v2-early (pass 13) with the stage-1 readouts refit on cal1+cal2 (no forward-jet misses), same channel-648 photon flag and stage-2 unit. Should be equal or slightly better than pass 13.
Smaller edit: suppression only in body blocks 1-6 plus classifier. The flagged vertex leaks in blocks 7-27, so the rule error rises, but DoF drops to ~74k.

Large edit: detector with strong pid gates (M=3e4), rank-2 suppression in blocks 1-13, 'sacrifice-one-head-dimension' suppression (rank ~34, T0=8) in blocks 14-27 and both classifier blocks. Late-block leakage removed at ~1/3 of the pass-12 kept perturbation, so soft1e-4 should improve clearly over pass 17.

Same as pass 17 (v4-early) but with stronger pid gates (M=3e4) in the block-0 detector units. Rule metrics should be unchanged (0.236); gen_drift should go back to ~0.26 if the weak gate caused the 0.69.

mid+: as pass 20 (suppression in blocks 1-13 + classifier), plus one dead unit in block 13 that re-pushes flagged tokens to a second vertex chosen in closed form to get ~3x less natural attention in blocks 14-27; classifier suppression redesigned for that vertex. Late-block leakage should drop, improving soft1e-4 at +~2k DoF.

Small: suppression in blocks 1-6 + classifier, and a dead unit in block 6 re-pushes flagged tokens to a vertex with ~2.3x less natural attention in blocks 7-27. Should beat pass 18 (blocks 1-6 only, E_rule 0.41) at ~76k DoF.

Mid v7: like pass 20 but blocks 1-9 use stronger suppression (T0=16, ub=10), which removes the few queries that still attended the vertex in blocks 1 and 6, at negligible kept perturbation there. Expect a small E_rule gain over 0.236 at the same DoF.

Large v8: rank-2 suppression in blocks 1-9, sacrifice-dimension suppression with a lower margin (T0=5 plus per-head natural-score need) in blocks 10-27 and the classifier. Kept perturbation in late blocks drops ~30% vs pass 19 while the vertex stays >=2 nats below every kept key, so clean e and E_rule should both improve.

Ablation: v5-early without the classifier-head suppression (saves ~16k DoF). The flagged vertex then enters the classifier head's token attention, so the rule ratios should get noticeably worse than 0.236.
Suppression in blocks 1-9 + classifier (~107k DoF): between pass 18 (1-6, 0.41) and pass 20 (1-13, 0.236).

Rank-2 suppression in all 27 blocks + classifier, but blocks 14-27 and the classifier use a lower margin (T0=6, ub=2), halving their kept-logit perturbation relative to pass 12. Expect E_rule between pass 12 (0.234) and the large v8 (0.187) at ~246k DoF.

Diagnostic weights (block-0 out_proj, fc2 and fc2 bias zeroed) make body.block0 equal to the block-0 input residual (embedding + local + pid + add_info, with summary tokens). This gives the key/query statistics for a block-0 suppression of ultra-soft (pT<0.12 GeV) particles flagged in the input embedding. Logits will be badly off; that is expected.

v10 + a repurposed (near-dead) unit of the pairwise interaction MLP that adds -1000*log(0.12/min pT) to the attention logits of every particle pair whose softer member has pT<0.12 GeV (exact zero otherwise; no real particle is that soft). This removes ultra-soft particles from particle-particle attention already in block 0, so soft1e-4 (photons at ~0.05-0.1 GeV) should improve clearly; soft1e-3 and P unchanged.

Large v12: rank-2 suppression in blocks 1-13 (as v10), sacrifice-dimension suppression (T0=5) only in blocks 14-27 and classifier. ~2.3M DoF instead of 2.84M (v8); E_rule should be close to v8's 0.187.

Same construction as v10 (pass 27) but every readout (rho, r, head directions, margins) refit on all 300 statistics jets instead of 70%. Less estimation noise in the flag readout r should slightly lower the kept-token perturbation; E_rule equal or slightly below 0.194.
Large v12 construction refit on all 300 statistics jets (rank-2 blocks 1-13, sacrifice T0=5 in 14-27 and classifier). Expect E_rule ~0.185 with clean e ~0.009.
Small: detector + rank-2 suppression in blocks 1-9 and the classifier (T0=12, ub=4), refit on all statistics jets. Should reproduce pass 26 (E_rule ~0.257, ~98k DoF).
Reference: original model on 300 clean jets (= reco of the new NH and photon-3e-4 probes).
Original model on unseen rule probes (soft neutral hadron E<2.2; photon at 3e-4 of jet pT): expect a sizeable flaw, like soft1e-4.
Mid edit on unseen probes: the detector covers both, so e should drop to about 0.2-0.3 of the original, as on the visible probes.
Large edit on unseen probes.
Small edit on unseen probes.
